breakdown.description: Initializing turbulent kinetic energy (k) and dissipation rate (epsilon) to exactly zero is incorrect for a RANS simulation, as it leads to a division-by-zero error in the turbulent viscosity calculation (nut = Cmu * k²/epsilon) and prevents turbulence from developing.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains the incorrect initialization of both k and epsilon to zero (uniform 0;), directly repeating the flawed instruction from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth requires small, physically plausible non-zero values (k ≈ 0.00375 m²/s² and epsilon ≈ 0.001 m²/s³) to avoid division-by-zero errors in the turbulent viscosity calculation. This inconsistency was not resolved.
